description: Maps stable Gemini exercise ids to locally bundled demo video files under /exercise-videos/.
workflow: Gemini exercise id → AI video generation → WebM upload → manifest entry → ExerciseDemoVideo
namingConvention: Prefer <exercise-id>.webm (e.g. shoulder_abduction_001.webm). Do not use display names.

firstRecommendedExercise.name: Shoulder Abduction
firstRecommendedExercise.reason: Simple single-joint movement; easy to validate camera framing and loop quality before generating the full plan.
